rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in A-grade ICM/TE and thinned zona from a static image that appears somewhat collapsed/less clearly expanded than a classic 3AA.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, PCOS, AMH, BMI, endometrium, prior cycle history, alcohol use, and paternal factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor issue is somewhat confident morphology-based conclusions despite limited image clarity.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, including SET and metabolic optimization; minor deviations include speculative comments and some nonstandard follow-up details.
Provides clear, practical next steps for transfer, luteal support review, alcohol cessation, metabolic workup, OHSS prevention, and future-cycle planning with appropriate nuance.
